subject: general
question: The Aravalli Range does NOT pass through ______ state of India.
solution:
The correct option is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Aravalli Range** is a mountain range in Northern-Western India.
 
• Its total length is about **670 km (430 mi)**.
 
• **Aravalli Hills** can be found in** Southern Haryana, Rajasthan and some parts of Gujrat**.
 
• The highest peak is **Guru Shikhar** on** Mount Abu** at** 1,722 metres (5,650 ft)**.
 
• **The Aravalli Range** is arguably the** oldest geological feature on Earth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The origin of **Aravalli Hills** is estimated of the** Proterozoic era**.
 
• **The Great Himalayan Ranges** are** 2,400 km (1500 miles) **in length. It separates **Tibetan Plateau** from the** Indian Subcontinent**.
 
• The highest peak in the world is **Mount Everest** with a height of** 8,850 m.**
 
• **The Vindhya** range extends up to **Gujarat in the west, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar in the north, and Chhattisgarh in the east**.
 
• **Narmada** river travels parallel to the** Vindhya ranges**.
